engineering_constraints.description: TCNF preparation: TEMPO oxidation, carboxylate content 2.2 mmol/g, aspect ratio 103
Directional freezing: dip rate 2 mm/min into liquid nitrogen (-196°C), freeze-dried 48h

design_translation.idea: Use TEMPO-oxidized cellulose nanofibers with wood-inspired honeycomb architecture for superfast, selective heavy metal removal from wastewater
examples: TCTGA aerogel: Pb 571 mg/g, Cu 462 mg/g, Cd 263 mg/g
87% Pb removal in 2 minutes, 100% in 10 minutes
Selective Pb capture over Na, K, Mg, Ca coexisting ions
design_translation.applicability: Heavy metal removal from industrial wastewater; selective Pb capture from multi-ion systems

knowledge_gaps: Performance with real industrial wastewater (complex matrix)
Long-term mechanical stability under repeated compression cycles
Scale-up from lab aerogel to industrial-scale production

narrative.text: Wood-inspired nanocellulose aerogels mimic the honeycomb architecture of natural wood with aligned macropore channels, enabling superfast ion transport and selective heavy metal capture. TEMPO oxidation provides abundant carboxylate groups for chemisorption.
